name: otelcol.receiver.cloudflare

arguments.name: endpoint
arguments.description: The <HOST:PORT> endpoint address on which the receiver awaits requests from Cloudflare.

arguments.name: max_request_body_size
arguments.description: Maximum request body size the receiver accepts, applied to the raw request body and again to the payload after gzip decompression. The receiver rejects larger requests with HTTP 422. Must be greater than 0.

arguments.name: secret
arguments.description: If this value is set, the receiver expects to see it in any valid requests under the X-CF-Secret header.

arguments.name: attributes
arguments.description: Sets log attributes from message fields. Only string, boolean, integer, or float fields can be mapped.

arguments.name: separator
arguments.description: The separator to join nested fields in the log message when setting attributes.

arguments.name: timestamp_field
arguments.description: Log field name that contains timestamp.

arguments.name: timestamp_format
arguments.description: One of unix, unixnano, or rfc3339, matching how your LogPush job encodes the timestamp field.

blocks.description: Configures where to send received telemetry data.
